activities_v2.name: #1 · Wild Turkey Golf Club
activities_v2.dist: On property — at Grand Cascades Lodge
activities_v2.when: Best: Sat 8–9 AM tee times, ~4.5 hrs
activities_v2.desc: The best course we can play staying here — 7,202 yds, top-10 ranked in NJ, and its par-3 7th over the lake quarry is rated the best par-3 in the state.

activities_v2.name: #2 · Crystal Springs Golf Club
activities_v2.dist: On property — at Grand Cascades Lodge
activities_v2.when: Best: Sat or Sun AM, ~4.5 hrs
activities_v2.desc: Golf Digest "Top 50 Toughest in America" — winds through a limestone quarry with big elevation changes. Bring extra balls.

activities_v2.name: #3 · Black Bear Golf Club
activities_v2.when: Best: Fri late-afternoon 9 or Sun AM
activities_v2.desc: The friendliest 18 of the three — scenic, playable for all skill levels. Good pick if the group has a wide handicap spread.

activities_v2.name: Minerals 9-Hole (casual round)
activities_v2.desc: Robert Trent Jones executive 9 — a top-12 short course in America. Perfect low-stakes warmup with drinks.

activities_v2.name: Skydive Sussex
activities_v2.when: Best: Sat AM slot, book ahead, ~3 hrs total
activities_v2.desc: 14,500 ft jump — the highest skydive in the Northeast. Weather-dependent, so reserve early and have a backup.

activities_v2.name: Mountain Creek Zip Tour
activities_v2.when: Best: Sat or Sun afternoon, ~2.5 hrs
activities_v2.desc: Ziplines up to 1,500 ft across the mountain, a suspension bridge, and a unimog ride back up.

activities_v2.name: Mountain Creek Waterpark
activities_v2.desc: 20+ slides, wave pool, and the Tarzan Swing free-fall for anyone recovering from Friday night.

activities_v2.name: Angry Erik / Krogh’s Brew Pub crawl
activities_v2.when: Best: Fri or Sat 5–8 PM, need drivers
activities_v2.desc: Closest craft stops — Angry Erik Brewing in Lafayette and Krogh’s brewpub on Lake Mohawk in Sparta.

activities_v2.name: ATV Off-Road Tour
activities_v2.when: Best: full Sat afternoon, ~4 hrs w/ drive
activities_v2.desc: Guided ATV tour through backcountry trails — the farthest option, so only worth it as the day’s main event.

activities_v2.name: Delaware Water Gap river tubing
activities_v2.when: Best: Sat or Sun 10 AM start, ~4 hrs w/ drive
activities_v2.desc: Lazy float down the Delaware with a cooler. Slow-paced but a classic group move.

activities_v2.name: Resort Archery & Laser Clay Shooting
activities_v2.desc: Included with the stay — easy competition to kick things off while everyone trickles in.

activities_v2.name: Appalachian Trail — Stairway to Heaven
activities_v2.desc: Steep climb to Pinwheel Vista — the best view in Sussex County. About 2.5 hrs round trip.

activities_v2.name: Reflections / Elements Spa Recovery
activities_v2.when: Best: Sun 10 AM — the hangover slot
activities_v2.desc: Two award-winning spas on property. Book treatments ahead; the pools and hot tubs need no reservation.

activities_v2.name: Restaurant Latour Steak & Wine Night
activities_v2.when: Best: Sat 7:30 PM, reserve now for 12
activities_v2.desc: Fine-dining tasting menu with a 135,000-bottle wine cellar — the group’s big night.

activities_v2.name: Firepits — Cigars & S’mores
activities_v2.desc: Drinks, cigars, and s’mores at the resort firepits — the default nightcap, no reservation needed.
